entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To check an order status, press one. For returns or exchanges, press two. To speak with a representative, press zero.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this absolute piece of junk you sent me. I bought this jersey a while back, and it's the completely wrong size. It's ridiculous.
I'm very sorry to hear that the item didn't fit as expected. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF-9942-811. And this is the last time I order from you people. This jersey is way too tight! I can barely breathe in it. You think everyone is a professional twig?

I understand your frustration, sir. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series Cycling Jersey, delivered 68 days ago. So the issue is that the jersey is too tight?

IS THAT NOT WHAT I JUST SAID?! Yes, it's the wrong size! I want to do an exchange or get my money back. And if you give me any trouble, I'm lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. I expect to speak to a manager if this isn't resolved in the next two minutes!
That won't be necessary, sir. I can resolve this for you right now. I'm just checking our policy. And yes, you're well within our 90-day return window for apparel.
So you're actually going to help me? No runaround?
Of course. There's no problem at all. We can process a full refund to your original payment method, or I can process an exchange for a larger size right now. The choice is yours.
Fine. Just... just send me the return label. I'll send this one back and think about whether I want to try another exchange later. The service is already a nightmare.

I've just generated that prepaid return label and sent it to the email address on your account. You should receive it shortly. Once we get the jersey back, the refund will be processed automatically. Is there anything else I can do for you?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
